GeneDef.label: innate time lattice
GeneDef.description:
A lattice grown through the carrier's nervous system lets them change the rate at which their own body experiences time. Nothing around them is affected - no field, no radius. Only they speed up, and only they slow down.

Running fast tears the tissue doing the running. The damage accumulates across days rather than clearing after a fight, and pushed all the way to four times normal the lattice will leave scars that never heal.

Run the other way and the same principle protects: at a third speed, a wound bleeds at a third the rate.
